description: Increasing icon size and spacing and raising maximum zoom to 2x immediately updates dock size and hover zoom.

assertions.comment: Changing icon size to 96px immediately sets the actual dock item cell size to 96px
Changing icon spacing to 16px immediately gives each dock item the new spacing value
The actual capture path of the unnamed Flow also reflects the 16px icon spacing

The actual capture path of the unnamed panel expands to 448px to contain four icons and their spacing. Panel width and height animate through Behavior, so inspect a settled frame rather than the frame immediately after the setting applies.
Dock surface height is recalculated as 178px for 96px icons and the default 1.6 zoom
Changing maximum zoom factor to 2.0 makes dock items use the new factor immediately
Dock surface height is set to 216px so 96px icons remain unclipped at 2x. The dock window itself grows when icon size changes, so inspect after layout settles.
The hovered icon smoothly zooms from 1.0 to the configured maximum factor of 2.0
